Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
mnw...@auracom.com (Martin Ward) writes:
>Now, is Dan Murdock's action to go get a Giant's Blood at +1 stealth? (ie same
>as equipping, employing and recruiting)

No. It is a zero-stealth, undirected, cardless action.
If successful, *then* you go through your library to find
a Giant's Blood.

Messages.Author: ianb...@aol.com
Messages.Body:
I got the promo vamps in less than a week from WOTC in Glasgow by
following their advice:

**Send a SSAE to Wizards of the Coast UK Ltd, PO Box 1562, Glasgow, G2 8BW
and mark your letter requesting the cards.

The limit is officially 2 of each vampire per household, but they sent me
3 each - maybe they liked my nice letter!

It was very funny this afternoon playing with both of them - my friends
were amazed and to see the look on their faces was excellent - they didn't
know about them as they are not connected to the Net!

By the way I played an Obf/Pres/Aus deck which worked very well!

Ian
